categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hisun Biomaterials Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, production, and sales of polylactic acid (PLA) bioplastics. Its main products include pure PLA and modified PLA resins, serving various downstream applications such as 3D printing materials, packaging, disposable tableware, and fibers. The company also operates subsidiaries engaged in biomaterials and additive manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes a proprietary two-step polymerization process (lactic acid to lactide to PLA) with advanced dehydration, ring-opening polymerization, and purification technologies. It has developed multiple patented technologies including multi-effect continuous evaporation, high-efficiency ring-opening catalysts, vacuum production, and controlled crystallization. The production emphasizes high optical purity, controlled molecular weight distribution, and chemical modification to enhance PLA properties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include polymer processing enterprises and manufacturers of downstream products such as packaging, disposable tableware, 3D printing materials, and fibers. The company serves domestic and international markets, with significant sales in Taiwan, Korea, Argentina, and Europe. The 3D printing sector is a rapidly growing market segment for the company’s specialized PLA resins.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Taizhou, Zhejiang Province. It has a growing presence in overseas markets including Taiwan, Korea, Argentina, and Europe. Sales are conducted primarily through direct sales domestically and via trade partners internationally, including key distributors in Guangdong and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Hisun Biomaterials operates primarily in the midstream segment of the PLA supply chain, producing PLA resins from lactic acid and lactide intermediates. The company is expanding upstream by securing lactic acid supply to ensure raw material stability and downstream by developing modified PLA products and applications. It controls the full industrial chain from raw material polymerization to resin sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in improving PLA production efficiency, product performance, and cost reduction. Key R&D directions include high optical purity PLA, molecular weight distribution control, chemical modification for enhanced heat resistance and toughness, and specialized PLA grades for 3D printing. It invests in pilot and scale-up projects, patent development, and industry collaborations to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of PLA resin products, including pure and modified grades. Sales are conducted via direct sales to polymer processors and through trade partners. The company also generates income from government subsidies and investment returns from subsidiaries. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance at a point in time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhejiang Hisun Biomaterials is a leading domestic PLA producer and the second globally to commercialize PLA production. It holds a dominant market share in China and competes internationally with companies like NatureWorks and TEC. The company is recognized for its advanced technology, product quality, and comprehensive PLA product portfolio, positioning it as a top-tier player in the bioplastics industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 845 million, a 12.2% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 35.5 million, down 18.5%. Total assets reached about RMB 2.07 billion with steady growth. The company is expanding production capacity with a 15,000-ton PLA project underway and maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 3% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary full-process PLA production technology, high product purity, and diversified PLA grades tailored for various applications including 3D printing and heat-resistant products. Its PLA products are certified for food safety and industrial compostability, offering environmentally friendly, biodegradable alternatives to traditional plastics. The company’s integrated supply chain and continuous innovation provide customers with reliable, high-quality, and sustainable bioplastic solutions.
